baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restriction, envoy title, possessive Rabb, and first-person gift clause in words 2-7.
baseline_models.mechanism: The envoy is the proximate speaker and delivery agent, while 'your Rabb' supplies ownership and authority; the promised boy is a gift without exchange rather than the envoy's possession or independent production.

activation_trace.role: The carried-message image identifies the speaker as bearer and makes delegated transmission the mechanism.
The lordship and ownership image locates ultimate authority in Mary's Rabb rather than in the envoy.
The no-compensation bestowal image defines the promised boy as benefaction, not exchange.

changed_reading.before: A visitor personally promises Mary a son.
changed_reading.after: A bounded envoy announces and mediates a gratuitous gift whose authority belongs to Mary's Rabb.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'your Rabb ... gift ... young boy ... zaki' in words 5-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nurture and completion, prior preparation, youth, and growth-purity form one developmental mechanism: what is given is a life prepared to mature well, not a finished object merely transferred.

activation_trace.role: The repair, nurture, and gradual completion image makes the Rabb the governor of the boy's development.
The preparation image casts bestowal as an already readied provision entering Mary's life.
The youth image supplies an immature human life whose future remains to unfold.
The growth and increase image turns zaki from a static compliment into a developmental trajectory.
The purity and soundness image specifies the ethical quality toward which that growth is ordered.

changed_reading.before: The gift is a boy who already bears a favorable adjective.
changed_reading.after: The gift is a prepared young life placed under a Rabb-directed trajectory of growth, purification, and completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening 'he said' followed by 'I am only a messenger' in words 1-4.
baseline_models.mechanism: An audible utterance carries a message that first identifies and limits its speaker, so the promise operates as credentialing speech before it operates as prediction.

activation_trace.role: The voiced-speech image makes the disclosure an audible act within the encounter.
The carrier-and-message image gives that speech borrowed authority and a defined communicative task.

changed_reading.before: The line merely reports what the visitor said.
changed_reading.after: The utterance performs authentication by naming the speaker's limited office before announcing the gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior sending of spirit into a represented, visibly human, complete form makes the focus claim 'only a messenger' an identity disclosure across the hidden-visible boundary: appearance is human, agency is dispatched.

activation_trace.role: The message-bearer image anchors the changed reading in the focus envoy title.
The sending and release image supplies the upstream dispatch that the focus speaker discloses.
The pictured-form image supplies embodiment as an interface rather than a change of ultimate sender.
The visibly skinned human image explains why the dispatched agency is initially read as an ordinary man.
The integrity and completeness image marks the assumed human form as coherent and fully presented.

structural_cues: 19:17 sequences barrier, divine sending, spirit, self-representation, and complete human appearance immediately before the focus disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch and complete human representation; I infer that the focus self-identification resolves the gap between visible form and sending agency. It may alternatively be simple narrative identification without a general interface model.

changed_reading.before: The speaker states an office title.
changed_reading.after: The speaker discloses that a convincing human appearance is the visible interface of dispatched, message-bearing agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's refuge in the Merciful and appeal to protective piety turn 'your Rabb' into an answer inside her safety test: the envoy's credential must place the approach under mercy and harm-prevention before the gift can be heard as gift.

activation_trace.role: The lordship image anchors the envoy's answer in the authority Mary invokes rather than in his own power.
The refuge and fastening image supplies Mary's active move into protection.
The mercy and tenderness image defines the invoked authority by care rather than threat.
The warding-off-harm image turns piety into the encounter's demanded behavioral constraint.

structural_cues: 19:18 is direct defensive speech, and 19:19 answers it with the restrictive 'only' before naming the gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refuge, mercy, and a piety condition; I infer that the credential is responsive to a safety test. Alternatively, these cues may characterize Mary without changing the office claim itself.

changed_reading.before: The envoy cites superior authority as a bare credential.
changed_reading.after: The envoy's appeal to Mary's Rabb answers a protective challenge and places his approach under mercy and non-harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's paired denials of human skin-contact and sexual transgression close the ordinary generative route. The focus gift verb therefore marks bestowed origination, while the envoy is excluded from the role of progenitor.

activation_trace.role: The gratuitous-bestowal image anchors the promised outcome in gift rather than reciprocal generation.
The young-boy image fixes the result whose ordinary causal route is questioned.
The sexual-contact image supplies the explicitly negated ordinary route.
The skin-meeting-skin image materializes the human contact Mary excludes.
The sexual-transgression image supplies the second negation and blocks an illicit alternative cause.

structural_cues: 19:20 repeats negation around two alternative human-sexual explanations and asks how the very 'boy' promised in 19:19 can occur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit denials of touch and transgression; I infer that they remove the envoy from donor-progenitor collapse. Alternatively, the denials may function chiefly as Mary's self-defense rather than a causal analysis.

changed_reading.before: The envoy's first-person 'I gift' can sound like personal production or possession.
changed_reading.after: The envoy voices bestowed origination while the next ayah expressly excludes him and every ordinary sexual route from progenitorship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease for the Rabb, deliberate making, visible sign, mercy, and executed determination expand the private gift into a public-purpose event. The boy is given to Mary yet made to signify and benefit beyond her.

activation_trace.role: The no-exchange gift image preserves the intimate recipient relation that context expands rather than cancels.
The ease and lightness image overturns the impossibility implied by ordinary causality.
The making-into-a-state image assigns the boy a purpose beyond merely coming to exist.
The manifest-sign image turns the private gift into publicly legible evidence.
The mercy image gives the public sign a beneficent social function.
The perfected-and-enforced action image frames the announced gift as executable determination.

structural_cues: 19:21 repeats 'your Rabb,' answers the causal question with ease, then uses a purpose clause before closing with a determined matter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, purposive making, sign, mercy, and completed determination; I infer that these are nested functions of the promised gift. A live alternative is that sign and mercy describe only the later person, not the gift relation in 19:19.

changed_reading.before: The promised boy is a private answer addressed to Mary.
changed_reading.after: The personal gift is simultaneously an executable decree designed as a public sign and mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pregnant carrying and labor place the gratuitous gift inside bodily cost; flowing water, deliberate shaking, falling ripe fruit, and harvesting place it inside material support and recipient action. Gift names source, not an effortless process.

activation_trace.role: The nurture-and-completion image anchors the subsequent material supports in Rabb-directed development.
The preparation image lets gift unfold as staged provision rather than instantaneous delivery.
The inward carrying and fruit image supplies the embodied duration of the promised outcome.
The labor-convulsion image supplies real bodily cost within the bestowed process.
The running-flow image supplies environmental relief beneath the laboring recipient.
The causing-to-shake image makes Mary's own exertion an operative link in provision.
The ripe fresh-date image supplies timely nourishment rather than abstract reassurance.
The harvesting-from-its-source image completes a provision chain that still requires reception.

structural_cues: 19:22-26 sequences carrying, withdrawal, labor, an underfoot flow, commanded shaking, falling fruit, eating, and drinking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily burden, pain, water, fruit, and commanded action; I infer that these reveal the operational form of a prepared gift. Alternatively, the provisions may comfort Mary without defining how the boy himself is gift.

changed_reading.before: A gratuitous gift should arrive without recipient cost or action.
changed_reading.after: The gift is gratuitous in source while unfolding through pregnancy, pain, ecological support, and Mary's embodied participation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary withholds speech and points; the promised child, from the prepared cradle-state, speaks and identifies a prophetic commission. Communicative agency passes from the first envoy to the gift, which becomes a new bearer of validating speech.

activation_trace.role: The voiced-utterance image anchors the initial act in a chain of later speech acts.
The message-carrier image supplies the relay structure that context extends to the child.
The restraining-the-tongue image creates a deliberate gap in adult verbal testimony.
The intelligible speech connecting interlocutors image specifies the channel Mary suspends.
The hand-indication image redirects the audience from Mary's absent speech to the child.
The prepared cradle image emphasizes the child's normally pre-verbal state.
The childhood image intensifies the reversal by locating testimony in the least expected speaker.
The child's voiced utterance fills the communicative gap and authenticates the announced outcome.
The God-reporting prophetic image shows the gift becoming a commissioned bearer in his own right.

structural_cues: Across 19:26-30, 'I will not speak' is followed by a gesture, a challenge about speaking to a cradle-child, and the child's direct 'he said.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies silence, gesture, improbable child speech, and prophetic identity; I infer a handoff of testimony from envoy to gift. The live alternative is that the child's speech only vindicates Mary and does not instantiate a messenger relay.

changed_reading.before: The envoy alone carries speech about a passive promised boy.
changed_reading.after: The envoy's message yields a boy who becomes the next speaking bearer and authenticates the gift from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: Communal shock, family-based suspicion, and sexual accusation make visible appearance an adverse verdict; the child's later fixed good, purification, filial beneficence, and rejection of coercive domination unfold zaki as an anticipatory counter-verdict proved over a life.

activation_trace.role: The purity and soundness image anchors the focus adjective against the adverse social reading.
The astonishing-event image supplies the community's first register of scandalous improbability.
The ugliness and badness image supplies the inherited moral comparison used against Mary.
The sexual-transgression image makes the accusation that the focus purity term preemptively contests.
The fixed and growing good image turns purity into durable benefit wherever the child is.
The purification image extends the focus adjective into an explicit lifelong practice.
The filial connection and beneficence image supplies observable ethical fruit.
The coercion and domination image is explicitly negated, defining purity also by non-tyranny.

structural_cues: 19:27-28 judge by apparent event and lineage; 19:30-32 answer with the child's own identity, practices, relation to his mother, and negated character traits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accusation followed by a program of durable good; I infer that later conduct operationalizes the earlier zaki descriptor. Alternatively, those traits may be independent biography rather than an unpacking of the adjective.

changed_reading.before: Zaki is a private assurance that the boy is innocent or good.
changed_reading.after: Zaki is a forward counter-verdict: social suspicion is answered by a life of purification, benefit, filial care, and non-coercion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The truth-claim becomes disputed, divine offspring is denied, transcendence is asserted, and decree moves through saying into occurrence; the shared Rabb claim then fixes the gift as created and commissioned life, not divine genealogy.

activation_trace.role: The bestowal-without-exchange image anchors a relation of gift that must not be converted into descent.
The reality-matching truth image frames the reported identity as a claim answerable to fact.
The sharp verbal disputation image supplies the controversy that pressures gift language toward genealogy.
The offspring-from-descent image names the relation explicitly denied of God.
The exoneration and transcendence image enforces the boundary against divine filiation.
The perfected-and-enforced action image supplies creation by effective determination rather than begetting.
The voiced-command image links the focus speech register to the decree's mode of execution.
The shared lordship image expands 'your Rabb' into the child's own creaturely allegiance and common worship.

structural_cues: 19:34 labels a disputed truth-saying; 19:35 juxtaposes denied offspring with decree and command; 19:36 says 'my Rabb and your Rabb.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit denial of offspring and an alternative decree-speech mechanism; I infer that this retroactively fences the gift wording in 19:19 against genealogical inflation. Alternatively, the correction may target later disputants without modifying the original promise.

changed_reading.before: A divinely given boy might be inflated from extraordinary gift into divine kinship.
changed_reading.after: The boy is extraordinary as a created, commissioned gift under a shared Rabb, while decree-speech explicitly replaces divine begetting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The private envoy utterance enters factional divergence, then moves toward witnessing, sharpened hearing and sight, decisive judgment, and return. Its authority is not measured by immediate social acceptance but by eventual disclosure and accountability.

activation_trace.role: The voiced-speech image anchors the later dispute and verification in the focus utterance.
The carried-message image gives the utterance a claim whose truth can outlast its first audience.
The taking-different-paths image supplies divergence from a single announced event.
The opinion-bound faction image turns disagreement into durable social formations.
The presence-with-witnessing image projects the claim toward an arena of disclosure.
The auditory-perception image intensifies eventual reception of what began as speech.
The visual-perception image adds direct seeing to delayed verification.
The decisive-judgment image closes the period in which the claim can remain contested.
The return image locates final accountability with the source of authority invoked in the focus.

structural_cues: 19:34-40 moves from truth-saying through dispute and factions to heightened perception, a decided matter, inheritance, and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies controversy followed by witnessing, perception, judgment, and return; I infer a delayed-verification arc for the focus message. Alternatively, this sequence may concern doctrinal consequences broadly rather than the encounter's credentialing speech.

changed_reading.before: The envoy's credibility depends on whether Mary or her community can accept the announcement immediately.
changed_reading.after: The messenger utterance is a claim carried through dispute toward eventual witnessing and judgment, so immediate reception is not its final measure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a concrete, branch-distant sense of the focus gift root. It remains anchored in word 6 and gains a visible material echo from the later running water and drinking; downstream prose should present it only as a provision-ecology analogy, never as the lexical translation of 'I gift.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb rooted in و ه ب at focus word 6.

activation_trace.role: The rain-holding hollow-in-rock image recasts gift as a prepared receptacle that preserves otherwise transient provision.
The running-flow image supplies the water that makes the receptacle analogy materially live.
The drinking image completes the movement from held provision to recipient sustenance.

changed_reading.before: Gift is a discrete object transferred to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, gift is also a prepared holding environment in which life-sustaining provision can gather, persist, and be received.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the erotic-force branch behind the focus noun for boy, not its ordinary youth sense. It remains anchored because the next ayah explicitly negates sexual contact and transgression; downstream prose must frame this as a blocked branch contrast, not as a characterization of the child.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The noun rooted in غ ل م at focus word 8.

activation_trace.role: The surging-sexual-desire image supplies a latent generative force only so context can negate its causal relevance.
The sexual-contact image is explicitly denied and blocks embodiment through ordinary intercourse.
The sexual-transgression image is also denied, closing the illicit causal route.

changed_reading.before: The boy noun contributes only age and sex.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its root's erotic-force branch is raised and immediately sealed off, sharpening the boy's arrival as severed from sexual causation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ق ل ل target mapped from the focus speech root. It remains anchored by the packet's split mapping and by later literal pregnancy-carrying; downstream prose should call it a form-distant load-bearing image, never replace the ordinary meaning 'said' with 'carried.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opening rooted in ق و ل at word 1, including its packet-supplied split target ق ل ل.

activation_trace.role: The carrying-and-rising image makes the opening utterance imaginatively bear and raise what it announces.
The carried-message image keeps the load analogy tied to communicative transmission.
The inward pregnancy-and-fruit image turns the utterance's announced burden into Mary's literal carrying.
The visible carrying image brings that once inward load before the community.

changed_reading.before: Speech ends when the announcement is uttered, and carrying begins later as a separate event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the utterance is load-bearing: it compresses a future burden that moves from message, to inward carrying, to public visibility.

strongest_changes: The first-person gift is delegated bestowal and is explicitly severed from sexual progenitorship.
A private promise expands into an executable public sign and mercy.
Gratuitous source coexists with pregnancy, labor, material provision, and recipient action.
Zaki becomes an anticipatory counter-verdict unfolded through the child's later ethical life.
Gift is firmly bounded away from divine filiation by decree-speech and shared lordship.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sentence is a relay point: hidden dispatch becomes visible credentialing speech, gift becomes embodied process, and the promised boy becomes a speaking bearer whose contested identity is carried toward public and final verification.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the protective reading modifies the envoy's office or only characterizes Mary's reception posture.
Whether later sign and mercy functions belong to the gift relation itself or only to the boy's subsequent role.
How much of the later ethical biography should be read as an unpacking of zaki rather than independent description.
The basin, blocked-erotic, and load-bearing activations are packet-anchored but deliberately branch-distant and should remain qualified.
